name: bounded-join-on-billion-span-project
sql: SELECT s.locale, count() AS evaluations, avg(e.score) AS mean_score FROM eval_results AS e JOIN sessions AS s ON e.session_id = s.id GROUP BY s.locale ORDER BY s.locale
scope_note: The project has at least one billion spans; each query intentionally reads only a one-hour window under the normal SQL resource caps. This is not a whole-billion-row scan claim. Use a dedicated environment, not a shared development stack.
